lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white stripes traversing the torso; spacing is widest at the anterior shoulder and becomes progressively narrower and denser towards the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 7th vertical stripe from the shoulder at the upper dorsal-lateral transition point.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 10th, 11th, and 12th stripes are fragmented into dashed or abbreviated segments that terminate before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior flank and the proximal region of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the lower posterior haunch align spatially to form a semi-linear horizontal geometric vector.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron marking on the bridge of the muzzle, two distinct white patches on the lower neck and throat, and white horizontal banding on the mid-carpal and mid-tarsal regions.
